Creative Tim dashboard repositories carried PolinRider loaders

Target: Creative Tim · repo
Date: Unknown Date
Target Kind: project_organization
Language: N/A
Impact: credential_theft

Synopsis

Four Creative Tim dashboard repositories contained malicious JavaScript at their default branch tips. The loaders used Ethereum transactions to resolve infrastructure for credential-stealing payloads.
